column1: # The release tags and how they compare: one table for every language that compares them - sh (tools/releases.sh,
# and its copy in mu300-update), Python (tools/release_pick.py), JavaScript (the web installer's version.js, and its
# copy in the panel's update.js), PowerShell (install.ps1). docs/FINDINGS.md 125.
#   vYYYY.MM.DD      the releases up to v2026.10.27, where the "day" was a counter
#   vYYYY.MM.DD.N    from then on: the real (UTC) day the release was built, N = 1..99 for the releases of that day;
#                    newer than every three-field tag whatever its date; compared by the date, then N, as numbers
#   bad TAG       not one (an empty TAG too)
#   cmp A R B     R is > (A is newer), < (B is newer), = (the same release) or ! (one of them is no release tag:
#                 neither counts as newer than the other)
